why: This is a specific immersive VR training platform for HDR vaginal cylinder brachytherapy rather than a general instructional element.
name: HDR VC brachytherapy immersive VR training platform
product_description: A Meta Quest 3 and edge-cloud-based virtual-reality platform developed by Ronghua Xu et al. for risk-free, repeatable procedural training in HDR vaginal cylinder brachytherapy.
